publication_text: Palantir careers directory, Internet Archive snapshot dated March 31, 2009. See the International section. “Earliest” refers to the materials verified for this book, not a claim of worldwide invention.

Two snapshots of the same Palantir job listing. They do not establish a company-wide date for a title change.
